headline: Revenue and EBITDA grow, but a higher tax rate hits earnings
summary_short: DT Midstream's Q2 2026 revenue rose 2.1% q/q and 11.0% y/y to $343M, but net income attributable fell 13.8% q/q to $112M ($1.09 diluted EPS) on lower equity-method earnings and a higher effective tax rate, even as EBITDA held flat q/q at $283M.
summary_long: Second-quarter revenue rose to $343M (+2.1% q/q, +11.0% y/y), with Gathering segment growth (Blue Union and Appalachia MVP-related volumes) offsetting a modest Pipeline segment revenue decline. Operating income rose to $173M (+4.2% q/q, +11.6% y/y). Net income attributable to DT Midstream fell to $112M (-13.8% q/q, +4.7% y/y; diluted EPS $1.09) as equity-method earnings from Millennium and NEXUS fell $10M and the effective tax rate rose to 32% from 24%. EBITDA held flat q/q at $283M, up 11.9% y/y. Cash rose to $172M after a $150M Guardian Term Loan funded a repurchase of $150M of senior notes; long-term debt was flat at $3,326M with no maturities until 2029. The filing states no quantified full-year guidance.

drivers.explanation: Gathering revenue rose $12M q/q on higher Blue Union and Appalachia (MVP expansion) volumes, more than offsetting a $2M Pipeline revenue decline from lower LEAP short-term contract and OFO fee revenue.

Pipeline segment equity earnings from Millennium and NEXUS fell $10M on lower seasonal contract revenue and higher opex, and the effective tax rate rose to 32% from 24%, partly offset by a stronger Gathering result.
Tracks the q/q net income decline; diluted share count was essentially unchanged (102.6M vs 102.7M).
Held flat q/q as Gathering segment revenue growth was offset by higher operation-and-maintenance and depreciation expense at Blue Union and other Gathering assets.
Gathering segment revenue growth outpaced a $4M rise in O&M expense from higher Blue Union production-related costs, lifting consolidated operating income.
Cash rose after Guardian's $150M term loan issuance funded a $150M repurchase of 2029/2031 senior notes, alongside six-month operating cash flow of $502M.
New $150M Guardian Term Loan proceeds were used to repurchase $150M of senior notes, leaving net long-term debt essentially unchanged y/y.

Company reiterates its natural gas-centric growth strategy across Pipeline (LEAP, Stonewall, Washington 10) and Gathering (Blue Union, Appalachia, Ohio Utica, Tioga) expansions, backed by ~$1.2B of available liquidity and no debt maturities until 2029; the filing gives no quantified full-year guidance.
